description: An AI agent cleans a customer table in a Svelte 5 data grid through tool calls, and every edit waits for a person: proposals drawn in their cells, grouped by what they change, accepted or rejected a group at a time, logged, undoable and revertible.
keywords: human in the loop ai svelte

faq.question: Which tools does the agent get?
faq.answer: createGridTools returns four: grid_describe (columns, row count, which fields it may edit), grid_query_rows (rows with their ids, filtered and paged), grid_propose_edits (edits as proposals with a reason and a confidence) and grid_review_status (what was accepted, rejected or went stale). Each is a name, a description, a JSON schema and an execute function, so any tool-use loop can call them.

faq.question: Can the agent write to the data directly?
faq.answer: No. grid_propose_edits adds proposals to the review; only an accept writes, and it first checks that each cell still holds the value the agent saw.

faq.question: Where does the audit trail come from?
faq.answer: createReview calls onDecision after every accept, reject, undo and redo with who decided and copies of the proposals. The demo's Log tab lists them; an app writes them to its own store.

faq.question: Does it work in a browser agent?
faq.answer: registerWebMcpTools registers the same tools with the browser's WebMCP API (document.modelContext), a draft that browsers are still adding. Where it is missing, the call does nothing.
